About.sectionSubtitle: BUILDING HIGH-PERFORMANCE WEB SYSTEMS & INDUSTRIAL AESTHETICS
About.bioDesc1: Specialized in high-fidelity interfaces, modern architecture, and extreme performance. Focused on industrial brutalism and uncompromising dark systems.
About.bioDesc2: I engineer web applications combining Next.js 15 and TypeScript power with precise motion physics (GSAP/Lenis) and scalable backends. Zero-slop code, brutal typography, and functional layouts challenging generic templates.
About.dir1Desc: Modular architecture, strict TypeScript typing, zero redundant dependencies.
About.dir2Desc: Spring physics and calculated kinematics. Zero slow decorative delays.
About.dir3Desc: Strict dark mode (#0a0a0a), visible structural grids, and uncompromising contrast.
